title: rhobound.ab-record/v1
description: What `rhobound diff-fit --baseline A --candidate B --loadgen-log L` writes (DATA.md 8): per service, the difference between the two arms of a concurrent A/B run, with standard errors by batch means, and the checks that decide whether the own-time difference may be applied alone. Only the CLI or server that computed a record mints measured-ab from it; a measured item enters a change set as delta +-2 standard errors.

overlap_share.description: share of the windows that overlap; below 0.9 is ab.not_concurrent

response_bytes.description: the mean response body the load generator read from each arm, bytes, when its log has the bytes column; a change of more than 10% is ab.payload_changed

loadgen.description: the load generator's own measurement of each arm, from outside the system under test

self_report_consistent.description: the client-side latency difference agrees with the span-derived one (profile.self_report_mismatch otherwise)

visits_needed.description: visits per arm the sizing rule needs for the gate's margin (ab.too_few_visits below it)

own_var.description: the own time's variance in each arm, ms^2, and its difference with the standard error by batch means: the evidence of a measured own_var_ms2 item

baseline_se.description: standard error of the baseline's mean calls per visit: sd/sqrt(n) over the visits (the counts are kept as a histogram, not in order, so not batch means)

calls.description: calls per visit to each callee, per arm

calls_changed.description: profile.structure_changed: the own-time difference is never applied alone

variance_changed.description: profile.variance_changed: the own time's variance differs beyond 2 standard errors (batch means). The variance, not the cs2: an own-time difference applied as a shift keeps the variance and lowers the cs2, so a pure shift is no variance change. With routes, against the variance the routes' own shifts predict (each route's variance kept, its mean moved by its delta, mixed by the candidate's shares)

route.description: as the fit names it (the SERVER span's http.route with its method, else its name 'METHOD /path', else its url.path), or other

routes.description: the own-time difference of each route both arms read (two or more, each at least 5% of the visits, at most 8, the rest as other); absent for a service with one route. A route moving apart from the blend beyond 3 standard errors is profile.route_heterogeneous

capture.description: the --baseline-name or --candidate-name given to `diff-fit`, else the arm's folder as given

images.description: image digests by service, from pod metadata in the spans

se.description: standard error of the delta, by the record's se_method
